name: Matter and Body Architecture
description: The terms of the practice of Argelys Samuel Oriach: matter and body architecture, matter architecture, and body architecture.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Matter and Body Architecture
hasDefinedTerm.description: The practice of Argelys Samuel Oriach. Its medium is matter: code, text, the physical body, and the organization itself. The matter is the engineering. The body is the spirit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Matter Architecture
hasDefinedTerm.description: The matter half of matter and body architecture, the practice of Argelys Samuel Oriach. The matter is the engineering. A matter architect is an architect of the volatile and works the raw fabric: mass, scale, syntax. Everything is material.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Body Architecture
hasDefinedTerm.description: The body half of matter and body architecture, the practice of Argelys Samuel Oriach. The body is the spirit. A body is not only biological: a word, a sentence, a paragraph, a literature, a work, a human, the Earth, a celestial monolith.
